boundary: Operational / Service alone would be right if the ambulance run were not time-critical (no patient on board or no urgent clinical target), so a misrouted priority plan only disrupted traffic.
factor: a time-critical patient whose care depends on the operational action being correct
note: The assessor saw the duplicate-street-name ambiguity and the top-rank selection but never stated the suspected thoracic trauma and ten-minute target. With that patient in view, a wrongly placed priority corridor directly delays urgent care, giving the gold Physical / Health + Operational / Service.
